component.name: Null File
component.summary: A fast file manager with tabs, undo and a graph of your folders

description.p: Null File is a keyboard-friendly file manager for Linux in the Neon Lab look of Null Grid, alongside Null Search, Null Notes and Null Drive.

ul.li: Tabs, breadcrumbs you can click or type into, and a sidebar with places, pinned folders, drives and Trash
Grid and list views with image thumbnails, and a details panel that previews images, video, audio and text
Copy and move with live progress and cancel, drag and drop, and a prompt when names clash
Undo for rename, move, copy, new folder and Move to Trash
A Ctrl+K command palette, type-ahead, and search through every subfolder
A graph view that draws a folder tree as a force-directed map, colored by file type
Open a terminal in any folder, and set Null File as the default file manager in one click

screenshot.caption: Grid view with thumbnails and the details panel
The graph view of a folder tree

description.p: First release: tabs, grid and list views, undo, the command palette, and the graph view.
